verdict.rationale: E2B's docs say every sandbox has outbound internet access by default, which can be restricted with an on/off switch or fine-grained allow and deny lists (e2b-docs-10). The Vercel AI SDK integration page also mentions outbound network controls (e2b-docs-44), so explicit egress policy is clearly delivered at the core. Missing for 10: detailed docs on policy syntax and granularity (domains/IPs/ports, per-template or org-wide defaults), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the allow/deny lists enforce as claimed.
